sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 25 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、MSFT、WEN、SNDK、META。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Micron (MU) became the absolute central axis of the session: Wednesday after-hours earnings were explosive: HBM4 ramp speed is "twice that of HBM3E," HBM4 revenue has already exceeded $1 billion, the company announced it will "return 100% of excess cash," and it secured approximately $22 billion in customer prepayments and commitments, on top of its previously announced multi-year supply agreement with Anthropic. It was once up +16% overnight, surged to $1254 at the open, then was slammed down to $1137, and is now at $1196 (+14.2%), with an intraday range of nearly 10%. SNDK at $2224 (+16%) outperformed MU, WDC +6.2%, and the memory sector strengthened independently.
  • Apple price hikes triggered Mag7 selling: This morning it officially announced 15–20% price increases across Mac/iPad/Vision Pro and other product lines (MacBook Pro $1699→$1999), explicitly saying this was "inevitable" due to soaring memory/storage costs. iPhone prices have not yet been adjusted. AAPL $279 (-4.7%), dipping to $276 intraday. The community interpreted it as a dual negative: "price hikes = demand destruction" + "memory costs backfiring on hardware makers."
  • Mag7 collectively bled, while capital rotated into memory/small caps/the Dow: MSFT $356 (-2.6%) hit a 52-week low (intraday $353.75, roughly -24% for the month) and became public enemy No. 1; PLTR $107 (-5.3%) and ORCL $152 (-3.1%) hit new lows, AMZN -1.5%, META -1.1%, GOOGL -1.0%, NVDA $196 (-1.3%) fell below $200. Mag7 collectively erased about $416 billion in market cap. Meanwhile, DIA +0.9%, IWM +0.8% (repeatedly making intraday highs), and TSLA unusually turned green (+0.3%).
  • Severe divergence between indices and individual stocks: SPY $735.56 (+0.31%, V-shaped recovery after an intraday low of 729.63), QQQ $716 (+0.77%, rebounding after plunging intraday to 705), propped up by MU/SNDK weighting, while the vast majority of components turned red. The community called it "index witchcraft."
  • PCE data landed: Headline PCE was 4.1% YoY (highest since April 2023), core 3.4%, both in line with expectations but still elevated; interest-rate futures show about a 30% probability of a July hike, rising to about 80% in September, with a year-end target rate of 3.8%.
  • Geopolitical disruptions: A cargo ship off Oman’s coast was hit by an unidentified projectile, and Iran’s Quds Force issued an ultimatum to Israel over southern Lebanon; the resumption of tanker traffic through Hormuz eased macro supply concerns, but USO +1.8% intraday was boosted by the Oman incident.

社区氛围：整体极度怨恨、混乱、悲观——大多数人在Mag7中都满载着未实现的损失，在开场的“史诗般的地毯拉力”中双方都收获颇丰，对MM/算法操纵的愤怒达到了顶峰。只有少数持有 MU/SNDK/BB 的公司在庆祝，而辞职情绪却在蔓延：“现金流才是真正的迷因；其他一切都是退出流动性。”

恐惧/贪婪：极度恐惧区域（延续昨天的 26-28），但分裂——记忆多头欣喜若狂，而 Mag7 和 meme 持有者则陷入绝望。 WSB情绪与实际市场行动：社会上充斥着“世界末日/熊市来了”的哀嚎，但指数实际上小幅上涨，IWM创出新高，道琼斯指数走强——这是目前最大的认知错配：散户严重增持的Mag7正在下跌，而他们鄙视的小盘股/价值股/道琼斯指数正在上涨。
